# RC40 — Duplicate current line or selected lines

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc d` / `core.duplicate-line` / `Duplicate Line/Selection`.
- With no selection, the command duplicates the current logical line immediately below itself and moves the cursor to the analogous column in the copy.
- With a selection, the command duplicates the full affected logical-line range below itself and selects the new copy so repeated duplication stays local and visible.
- EOF-without-final-newline cases insert the necessary newline before the copy.
- The operation is one dirty undoable edit and read-only IDE views refuse it.
- Compact help, action footer, command palette, keymap reference, README, and iPad QA now expose the route.
